articles.summary: Rithm Capital Corp. (NYSE: RITM; “Rithm Capital,” “Rithm” or the “Company”) today reported the following information for the second quarter ended June 30, 2024: Second Quarter 2024 Financial Highlights : GAAP net income of $213.2 million, or $0.43 per diluted common share (1) Earnings available for distribution of $231.1 million, or $0.47 per diluted common share (1)(2) Common dividend of $122.4 million, or $0.25 per common share Book value per common share of $12.39 (1) Q2 2024 Q1 2024 Summary
articles.title: Rithm Capital Corp. Announces Second Quarter 2024 Results
